text.tspan: Japan is an island nation in East Asia, comprising nearly 7,000 islands
in the Pacific Ocean. The four main islands—Honshu, Hokkaido,
Kyushu, and Shikoku—make up about 97% of the country's land area.
• Capital: Tokyo (world's most populous metropolitan area)
• Government: Constitutional monarchy with parliamentary system
Japan is the world's third-largest economy by nominal GDP and a
global leader in technology, automotive manufacturing, and robotics.
Known as the "Land of the Rising Sun," Japan seamlessly blends ancient traditions with cutting-edge modernity. From the serene temples of Kyoto
to the neon-lit streets of Tokyo, the country offers visitors an extraordinary cultural experience unlike anywhere else in the world.

g.text: Vibrant capital with modern tech, anime culture, and imperial history
Ancient temples, traditional geisha districts, and serene gardens
Street food paradise, historic castle, and lively entertainment
Peace Memorial, floating torii gate, and scenic island beauty
Iconic volcano views, hot springs, and mountain resort towns
Pristine wilderness, world-class skiing, and fresh seafood

svg.text: 💡 Pro Tip: Get a JR Pass for unlimited travel on Japan Rail—ideal for exploring multiple cities!
Sources: World Bank (GDP data), Statistics Bureau of Japan (population data), Japan National Tourism Organization
